concept.shortdesc: Following are the new features introduced in this release:

conbody.p: Following are the new features introduced in this release:

task.shortdesc: You can now configure the fields available for search functionality during the check-in and check-out

context.p: You can now configure the fields available for search functionality during the check-in and check-out process. This feature enhances the searching experience.

title.ph: Updating Additional Values during Check-In Process

task.shortdesc: You can configure additional fields to be available during the check-in process. You can add

context.p: You can configure additional fields to be available during the check-in process. You can add or update the values of the additional field records during check-in. This feature is available for all the Microsoft Office applications that are supported by Chatter.

concept.shortdesc: Following are the new features introduced in this release:

conbody.p: Following are the new features introduced in this release:

concept.shortdesc: X-Author for Chatter has been updated to accommodate Salesforce’s retirement of the TLS 1.0 encryption

conbody.p: X-Author for Chatter has been updated to accommodate Salesforce’s retirement of the TLS 1.0 encryption protocol for inbound and outbound connections.

concept.shortdesc: Administrators can now configure X-Author for Chatter settings to display a custom chatter icon in

conbody.p: Administrators can now configure X-Author for Chatter settings to display a custom chatter icon in the Chatter task pane in MS Office. In this version, X-Author Chatter introduces new System Properties defined as a Custom Setting in Salesforce to specify custom Chatter icons and the Static Resource holding these icons.
